title: Executable Code Actions Elicit Better LLM Agents
authors_zh: Xingyao Wang, Yangyi Chen, Lifan Yuan, Yizhe Zhang, Yunzhu Li, Hao Peng, Heng Ji
paper_type_zh: 可执行智能体示范数据集与 SFT 配方
best_for_zh: 适合用代码 action、执行反馈与自我调试轨迹训练工具型智能体的研究者。
one_line: CodeActInstruct turns five task suites into 7,139 filtered multi-turn demonstrations of executable Python actions, observations, and self-corrections for SFT.
CodeActInstruct 将五类任务改造成 7,139 条可执行 Python action、环境反馈与自我纠错的多轮示范，用于智能体监督微调。
why: It makes the usually hidden interaction and recovery trace a reusable training object while exposing the task mixture and acceptance rules.
inclusion_reason: CodeActInstruct releases static, multi-turn code-action demonstrations with explicit teachers, environment feedback, success filtering, and SFT consumers rather than only proposing an online agent scaffold.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM agents usually emit text or rigid JSON tool calls. Those formats make it difficult to compose several tools, reuse intermediate values, or react to execution errors without custom parsing. CodeAct asks whether executable Python can serve as a common action language, and whether the resulting interactions can become reusable supervision rather than remaining transient online episodes.

The Track 01 object is CodeActInstruct: 7,139 static multi-turn conversations that serialize an instruction, model reasoning, executable code, environment observations, corrections, and a terminal solution. Teachers generate the traces, task metrics and environment outcomes select successful episodes, and Llama-2/Mistral consumers learn them through SFT.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv 2402.01030, accepted by ICML 2024; open dataset xingyaoww/code-act, with 7,139 trajectories and 10,581,681 Llama-2 tokens; construction, filtering, task mixture, training consumer, results, and execution risks verified, while the official paper view does not disclose author affiliations.

LLM 智能体通常输出文本或格式固定的 JSON tool call；这两种形式都难以组合多个工具、复用中间变量，也需要额外解析逻辑才能根据执行错误调整行动。CodeAct 要回答两个问题：可执行 Python 能否成为统一 action 语言，以及这些交互能否从一次性的在线 episode 变成可复用监督。

本文在 Track 01 中的核心对象是 CodeActInstruct：7,139 条静态多轮对话，逐轮保存任务指令、模型思考、可执行代码、环境反馈、纠错过程与最终答案。teacher 负责生成轨迹，原任务指标和环境结果筛选成功 episode，Llama-2 与 Mistral 再通过 SFT 消费这些记录。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv 2402.01030，已被 ICML 2024 接收；开放数据 xingyaoww/code-act 包含 7,139 条轨迹和 10,581,681 个 Llama-2 token；构造、筛选、任务混合、训练消费者、实验与执行风险均已核对，但官方论文页面未披露作者机构。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CodeActInstruct converts hard examples from five existing task suites into executable multi-turn demonstrations. GPT-3.5, Claude, and GPT-4 act through Python, observe search results, table outputs, simulator states, or tracebacks, and revise their plans; the pipeline retains successful, parseable episodes and deliberately favors trajectories that recover from an earlier error. The released records are SFT targets, which is why this Card belongs to instruction/demonstration/rationale data even though the substrate is an agent environment; work that releases only an online environment or benchmark is the closest excluded neighbor.

Google Scholar citations: 694（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Executable+Code+Actions+Elicit+Better+LLM+Agents&author=Xingyao+Wang&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset name: CodeActInstruct. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xingyaoww/code-act. Scale: 7,139 CodeAct trajectories and 10,581,681 Llama-2 tokens. Record form: instruction, thought, executable Python action, environment observation/error, revisions, terminal solution, and success outcome. File/storage format: one CodeAct Parquet shard plus a separate general-conversation Parquet shard. Domains/languages: English information seeking, mathematics, code, table reasoning, and robot planning. Construction and filtering: GPT-3.5/Claude/GPT-4 interact with executable tasks; original metrics verify success and heuristics retain parseable, useful, self-correcting episodes. License/access constraints: public Apache-2.0 dataset; upstream source terms still require review. Intended use: SFT and agent training.

CodeActInstruct 把五个既有任务集中的高难样本改造成可执行的多轮示范。GPT-3.5、Claude 与 GPT-4 通过 Python 行动，接收搜索结果、表格输出、模拟器状态或 traceback，再修订后续计划；流程只保留成功且可解析的 episode，并有意优先选择能够从早期错误中恢复的轨迹。公开记录直接作为 SFT target，因此即使底层依赖智能体环境，本 Card 仍属于指令、示范与理由数据；只发布在线环境或 benchmark、没有静态训练轨迹的工作是最接近但被排除的相邻方向。

Google Scholar 引用数：694（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Executable+Code+Actions+Elicit+Better+LLM+Agents&author=Xingyao+Wang&hl=en）

开源数据：有。数据集名称：CodeActInstruct。官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/xingyaoww/code-act。规模：7,139 条 CodeAct 轨迹、10,581,681 个 Llama-2 token。记录形式：任务指令、思考、可执行 Python action、环境 observation/错误、修订、最终答案与成功结果。文件/存储格式：一个 CodeAct Parquet 分片，另有一个通用对话 Parquet 分片。领域/语言：英文信息检索、数学、编程、表格推理与机器人规划。构造与筛选：GPT-3.5、Claude、GPT-4 与可执行任务交互，原任务指标验证成功，启发式规则保留可解析、有用且能自我纠错的 episode。许可/访问限制：公开 Apache-2.0 数据集，上游来源条款仍需复核。预期用途：SFT 与智能体训练。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Choose hard tasks. Sample 3,000 HotpotQA, 5,586 MATH, 4,439 APPS, 3,000 WikiTableQuestion, and 3,553 ALFWorld instances after task-specific difficulty filtering.
  2. Expose executable interfaces. Provide Wikipedia search functions, Python mathematics and coding packages, pandas/SQLite tables, or ALFWorld control APIs. Single-turn problems are repurposed to permit several thought, execute, observation, and answer turns.
  3. Generate trajectories. GPT-3.5 Turbo and Claude 1/2 attempt the tasks through MINT; the long-context GPT-3.5 variant handles APPS, and GPT-4-0613 attempts a subset unsolved by the other teachers.
  4. Verify and select. Original task metrics judge terminal correctness. Keep actions that parse and execute under CodeAct; discard malformed calls, episodes containing only execution errors, and odd-turn records that never answer the user. Among multi-turn successes, preserve traces that correct an earlier mistake.
  5. Package and consume. Release 7,139 trajectories: 1,664 search, 1,732 math, 647 coding, 1,065 table, and 2,031 robot-planning records. Mix them with 69,230 general conversations for full-parameter SFT of Llama-2 7B and Mistral 7B.

Reproduction should pin teacher versions, source revisions, MINT prompts, execution images, tool packages, task checkers, and dataset revision. The paper does not consolidate teacher cost or random seeds into a complete generation budget.

1. 选择高难任务。 经各数据集自己的难度筛选后，抽取 3,000 条 HotpotQA、5,586 条 MATH、4,439 条 APPS、3,000 条 WikiTableQuestion 与 3,553 条 ALFWorld 候选。
  2. 提供可执行接口。 分别暴露 Wikipedia 搜索函数、数学和编程 Python 包、pandas/SQLite 表格或 ALFWorld 控制 API；原本的单轮问题被改造成允许多轮思考、执行、观察与作答的任务。
  3. 生成轨迹。 GPT-3.5 Turbo 与 Claude 1/2 在 MINT 中尝试任务；长上下文 GPT-3.5 处理 APPS，其他 teacher 都未解出的一个子集再交给 GPT-4-0613。
  4. 验证并筛选。 原任务指标判断最终答案是否正确。只保留能按 CodeAct 解析和执行的 action；删除格式错误、所有执行均报错，以及轮次结构异常且未回答用户的 episode。对多轮成功记录，优先保留能够修正早期错误的轨迹。
  5. 打包并训练。 最终公开 7,139 条轨迹：搜索 1,664 条、数学 1,732 条、编程 647 条、表格 1,065 条、机器人规划 2,031 条。它们与 69,230 条通用对话混合，用于 Llama-2 7B 和 Mistral 7B 的全参数 SFT。

复现时应固定 teacher 版本、上游数据 revision、MINT prompt、执行镜像、工具包、任务 checker 与发布 revision。论文没有把 teacher 调用成本和随机种子汇总成完整生成预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
1. With the Mistral 7B backbone, CodeActAgent reaches 57.4 success on in-domain MINT and 32.4 on out-of-domain MINT, versus 18.8 and 9.7 for Mistral Instruct. On out-of-domain M3ToolEval it reaches 12.2 while the same-size instruction baseline scores 0.0. These controlled comparisons support the usefulness of the trajectory mixture for executable agent behavior.
  1. The paper reports 24% and 119% relative improvement over same-backbone AgentInstruct and FireAct variants, while generic-task performance is largely preserved: the Mistral CodeActAgent records 59.1 MMLU, 34.7 HumanEval, 58.0 GSM8K, and 8.2 MT-Bench. This supports transfer beyond the source tasks, but the best training mixture also includes 69,230 general conversations, so gains cannot be attributed to CodeActInstruct alone.

1. 在同为 Mistral 7B backbone 时，CodeActAgent 的 MINT 域内与域外成功率分别为 57.4 和 32.4，而 Mistral Instruct 只有 18.8 和 9.7；在域外 M3ToolEval 上，前者为 12.2，同规模 instruction baseline 为 0.0。这组受控比较支持多轮轨迹对可执行智能体行为的训练价值。
  1. 论文报告，相对同 backbone 的 AgentInstruct 与 FireAct 变体，CodeActAgent 的提升分别为 24% 和 119%；通用能力大体保留，Mistral 版本在 MMLU、HumanEval、GSM8K 与 MT-Bench 上分别为 59.1、34.7、58.0 和 8.2。这说明收益能超出源任务，但最佳训练还混入 69,230 条通用对话，不能把全部提升都归因于 CodeActInstruct。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier agent-tuning sets usually serialized text-form tool calls or narrow single-tool demonstrations. CodeActInstruct changes the auditable training object: executable Python actions, observations, tracebacks, and successful revisions remain together in one multi-turn record, with original task metrics deciding terminal success. The ICML acceptance, explicit five-domain mixture, public records, and controlled SFT comparisons are quality signals. What is not new is code generation itself or environment feedback alone; the reusable change is packaging recovery-bearing interactions as training demonstrations. Reuse checks should focus on execution safety, inherited licenses, source/evaluation overlap, and teacher artifacts.

更早的智能体微调数据多把 tool call 写成文本，或只覆盖单一工具的狭窄示范。CodeActInstruct 改变的是可审计训练对象：可执行 Python action、环境 observation、traceback 与成功修订被保存在同一条多轮记录中，最终是否成功仍由原任务指标判定。ICML 接收、明确的五领域混合、公开记录与受控 SFT 比较提供了质量信号。代码生成本身或单独使用环境反馈并非新意；真正可复用的变化，是把带纠错过程的交互打包成训练示范。复用检查应集中在执行安全、继承许可、源任务与评测重叠，以及 teacher artifact。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Terminal task success does not verify the faithfulness, minimality, or safety of each intermediate thought and code action. Audit sampled trajectories step by step, run static plus dynamic code checks, and replay only inside per-episode isolation with resource, network, and allowlist restrictions.
  • MATH and ALFWorld occur in both synthesis sources and parts of MINT. Preserve the paper's in-domain/out-of-domain separation and rerun overlap checks for any new evaluation suite.
  • Teachers and Python environments imprint syntax, package versions, error messages, and recovery habits. Pin the execution image and compare against alternative teachers before treating the behavior as general.

• 最终任务成功并不能证明每一步思考与代码 action 都忠实、必要或安全。复用前应逐步抽查轨迹，同时执行静态与动态代码检查，并只在逐 episode 隔离、资源和网络受限且有明确 allowlist 的环境中重放。
  • MATH 与 ALFWorld 既是合成来源，也出现在部分 MINT 评测中。必须保留论文的域内/域外区分，并对新的评测集重跑重叠检测。
  • teacher 与 Python 环境会留下语法、包版本、错误信息和纠错习惯。应固定执行镜像，并与其他 teacher 生成结果比较后再判断行为能否泛化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the 7,139 released records as SFT demonstrations when the target agent must learn to react to execution output and recover from errors, not merely emit a one-shot tool call.
  • Reuse the construction checklist: hard-source sampling, executable interface, multi-teacher rollout, task-metric success, parseability checks, and recovery-focused selection.
  • Treat domain counts and ID/OD evaluation as required reporting fields. Preserve source IDs, teacher identity, every observation, terminal checker result, and the execution-image digest.

• 当目标智能体需要根据执行输出调整行动并从错误中恢复，而不只是生成一次性 tool call 时，可把公开的 7,139 条记录作为 SFT 示范。
  • 可复用其构造清单：高难源题采样、可执行接口、多 teacher rollout、原任务指标验收、可解析性检查，以及面向纠错的筛选。
  • 应把领域计数与域内/域外评测作为必报项，同时保留源记录 ID、teacher 身份、每次 observation、最终 checker 结果和执行镜像摘要。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The reusable object is 7,139 static SFT trajectories, not the Python environment by itself.
  2. Each trajectory exposes thought, executable action, observation or traceback, revision, and terminal answer.
  3. Original task metrics establish success; additional heuristics remove malformed, all-error, and non-answering episodes.
  4. The strongest clean signal is the Mistral 7B MINT-OD increase from 9.7 to 32.4, with M3ToolEval rising from 0.0 to 12.2.
  5. Before reuse, audit source licenses, ID/OD overlap, teacher artifacts, and sandbox boundaries.

1. 可复用对象是 7,139 条静态 SFT 轨迹，而不是 Python 环境本身。
  2. 每条轨迹都暴露思考、可执行 action、observation 或 traceback、修订过程与最终答案。
  3. 原任务指标确认是否成功，附加启发式规则再删除格式错误、全程报错和未作答的 episode。
  4. 最清晰的证据是 Mistral 7B 的 MINT 域外成功率从 9.7 升到 32.4，M3ToolEval 从 0.0 升到 12.2。
  5. 复用前应审计上游许可、域内/域外重叠、teacher artifact 与 sandbox 边界。

value.html: Challenging training instances sampled from HotpotQA, MATH, APPS, WikiTableQuestion, and ALFWorld, repurposed as interactive tool-use tasks.
A serialized multi-turn conversation containing an instruction, thought, executable Python action, environment observation or error, revised actions, and a terminal solution.
GPT-3.5, Claude 1 Instant, Claude 2, and GPT-4 generate multi-turn trajectories under the CodeAct protocol.
Python execution plus task-specific search, table, mathematics, coding, and ALFWorld interfaces exposed as functions or packages.
Original task metrics and environment outcomes determine trajectory success; parsing, error-recovery, and turn-structure heuristics perform final selection.
Retain successful trajectories that obey code-as-action syntax, contain useful interactions, and, for the self-improvement subset, recover from an earlier execution error.
Llama-2 7B and Mistral 7B are supervised-fine-tuned as CodeActAgent consumers.
GPT-3.5 Turbo, Claude 1 Instant, Claude 2, and GPT-4-0613.
MINT runs teachers against executable task environments for multiple turns and records thoughts, code actions, observations, corrections, and submitted solutions.
Down-sample each source toward harder tasks, use three primary teacher families, and send tasks unsolved by them to GPT-4-0613.
Keep successful, parseable CodeAct trajectories; reject malformed actions, all-error episodes, and odd-turn records that fail to answer the user; emphasize episodes that correct an earlier error.
The release contains 7,139 trajectories and 10,581,681 Llama-2 tokens; teacher call counts, token prices, and total generation cost are not reported as one budget.
Full-parameter SFT on CodeActInstruct mixed with 69,230 general-conversation records; context length is 4,096 for Llama-2 and 16,384 for Mistral.
1,664 HotpotQA, 1,732 MATH, 647 APPS, 1,065 WikiTableQuestion, and 2,031 ALFWorld trajectories.

The official release packages 7,139 training trajectories; the paper evaluates separately on in-domain and out-of-domain MINT tasks but does not define a standalone held-out split for the released SFT set.

Source-task train subsets are used for synthesis and some MINT evaluation domains overlap with MATH and ALFWorld, so the paper reports ID and OD results separately rather than claiming universal decontamination.

items: Success metrics validate terminal task outcomes, not the faithfulness or safety of every intermediate thought and code action.
Teacher-specific syntax, self-correction style, and error patterns can be distilled into the student along with useful behavior.
Executable actions create sandbox-escape and unsafe-code risks if the release is replayed outside a hardened environment.

value.html: The official dataset card declares Apache-2.0 and the code repository declares MIT; upstream HotpotQA, MATH, APPS, WikiTableQuestion, and ALFWorld terms still apply to derived records.

Static SFT demonstrations generated from five task datasets through executable interaction; the closest neighboring category is agent/environment trajectories, but the released serialized episodes are explicitly consumed as instruction-tuning targets.
